verdict.rationale: Founder Law's pricing page lists "Full Legal Defense For Any Potential RFE and NOID" as part of its packages, and its About page says packages cover "any RFE responses," so RFE/NOID response work is explicitly part of the offering. However, these are brief inclusion statements rather than real documentation of how the work is done. Missing for 10: any description of the RFE/NOID response process or deliverables, outcomes or track record on RFE/NOID cases, and independent or client corroboration.
